title: Oprah and Dwayne Johnson’s Maui fund distributed $60 million to over 8,100 fire survivors
summary_full: Oprah Winfrey and Dwayne Johnson spearheaded the People’s Fund of Maui aimed at aiding wildfire survivors with financial support. Over $60 million was allocated to more than 8,100 affected residents during the recovery phase. Eligible adults were granted monthly payments of $1,200 to assist with essential needs. This initiative was created in conjunction with local elders and leaders, enabling survivors to focus on their most urgent requirements.
